jobs.occupation: Customer Service Officer: English + Czech + Polish OR Lituanian - Multiple shifts - Oostakker
jobs.description:
For our client we're looking for a Customer Service Officer.
In this role, you become the voice of support for drivers facing unexpected vehicle issues across Europe. You'll be part of a fast-paced and multilingual contact center where your communication skills, empathy, and sense of urgency play a crucial role in keeping transport moving.
 

 
• Handle incoming assistance requests from international customers experiencing roadside vehicle breakdowns. 
 
• Take ownership of each case by coordinating with local service providers and technicians until the issue is resolved. 
 
• Maintain constant communication with both the customer and service partner, providing regular updates and reassurance. 
 
• Think on your feet and apply a proactive approach to problem-solving, often finding creative solutions under time pressure. 
 
• Be an integral part of a tight-knit, multilingual team that thrives on collaboration and mutual support. 
 
• Operate within a 24/7 environment, where teamwork and flexibility are essential to ensuring seamless customer experiences. 

- You speak and write fluently in English + Czech, and Lithuanian and/or Polish 

 
• You are service-driven and naturally inclined to go the extra mile to support customers in stressful situations. 
 
• Strong interpersonal skills help you adapt your communication style to various cultural and professional contexts. 
 
• You enjoy working in a diverse team setting and are always ready to help others succeed. 
 
• Flexibility to work in a rotating shift schedule, including nights and weekends. 
 
• A hands-on mentality with a structured and solution-oriented mindset. 
 
• Eagerness to continuously develop your skills and embrace new challenges.

jobs.occupation: Handyman / general facilities technician - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician with solid electrical knowledge and a passion for maintenance, repairs, and problem-solving? Do you enjoy having variety in your work and being the go-to person for all technical issues? And are you already living in Belgium?

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician or handyman to help maintain the buildings, warehouse facilities, technical installations and outdoor areas. A very varied job that combines electrical maintenance, facility maintenance, repairs, troubleshooting and general handyman tasks. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you're responsible for a wide range of maintenance and repair activities across the different sites of the company. You and the rest of the technical team use your technical skills to ensure the operations run safely and efficiently.

Your key duties:

• Perform electrical maintenance and repairs
• Carry out minor repairs to plumbing, storage racks, equipment...
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers

Your profile:

• Good knowledge of electrical systems and installations
• Basic knowledge of plumbing, mechanics, building maintenance, or general technical repairs
• Experience as a maintenance technician, handyman, facilities technician, general maintenance worker...
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English
 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

For a client in the metal industry, we are looking for an operator.

You will be responsible for operating the profiling line, ensuring the smooth handling of both the input and output of the machines. You will work in a two-shift system or a fixed night shift.

Your responsibilities:

• You will create registrations in MII/SAP. You retrieve production orders and transmit the required quantities and lengths to the machine. You perform the prescribed measurements, compare them with the specified tolerances, and adjust the process where necessary.

• You are responsible for packaging the finished product according to the given instructions.

• You handle the transport of finished goods using an overhead crane or forklift, including the required scanning and administrative registrations.

• You have completed a technical education and are able to operate a forklift confidently.

• A valid forklift certificate is considered a strong advantage.

• You have solid technical knowledge and/or a technical background.

• Experience with an overhead crane is a strong asset.

• You prioritize safety and quality at all times.

• You are able to work independently with a high level of reliability.

• You communicate fluently in English.

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

Historically recognized as the global benchmark for premium retail equipment and trolley manufacturing, 
Wanzl has successfully evolved into a 
total solutions provider optimizing customer experiences.
 

To support the ambitious course in Belgium and Luxembourg, Wanzl is looking for an entrepreunerial Business Development Manager.  This role is pivotal in driving the new era, turning premium product innovations and digital solutions into sustainable market share.
 

As Business Development Manager, you act as 'co-architect' of the business transformation in BeLux, supporting the General Manager. You combine traditional sales with high-level strategic business development to gain market share with new, digital, and automated solutions. You pioneer new growth areas while further expanding existing strategic partnerships.
 
 

• You further design and implement a sustainable go-to-market strategy to successfully position the renewed Wanzl portfolio in the market. 

• You take responsibility for major, existing key accounts in retail and proactively expand the C-level relationship network within complex Decision Making Units. 

• You actively identify market opportunities for product innovations (such as digital retail and automation solutions) and lead the acquisition process from A to Z, including complex price negotiations. 

• You implement structured and data-driven sales management (CRM, forecasting, and account planning) to achieve commercial performance and strict P&L and margin targets. 

• You work closely with the local sales and operational teams and the international headquarters to guarantee an optimal customer journey and efficient collaboration. 
 

• You hold a university degree and have 10 to 15 years of proven successful B2B sales and business development experience, preferably in retail or other relevant sector. 

• You are accustomed to operating in highly competitive markets and have experience managing complex key accounts. 

• You combine a strong commercial and entrepreneurial mindset with analytical skills and a P&L and margin focus, capable of translating data into concrete actions. 

• You have a proactive hands-on mentality and enjoy taking independent initiative to drive the business forward. 

• You communicate convincingly at various levels and are fluent in Dutch and French (required for the local market), as well as English (communications with HQ and other affiliates). Knowledge of German is a nice plus.

jobs.description:
Our client is looking for a Customer Experience Specialist to support and further develop their French-speaking customer base. In this role, you will ensure an outstanding customer journey from order placement to delivery and after-sales support while building long-term customer relationships.

 

Client Details

Our client is an internationally recognised company, operating within the lifestyle industry. 
With a strong focus on innovation and customer satisfaction, our client has built an excellent reputation in both B2B and B2C markets. To strengthen their customer experience team, they are currently looking for a service-driven professional with a strong affinity for the French market.
 
Company is located in the region of Kontich/Edegem. Easy connection with car & public transport.

 

Description

• Act as the primary point of contact for customers in the French market (B2B).
• Advise customers on products, collections, and available solutions.
• Handle customer enquiries via phone and email in a professional and solution-oriented manner.
• Process, manage, and follow up on orders within the ERP system.

• Manage customer complaints and provide effective and customer-focused solutions.
• Support commercial initiatives, quotations, and after-sales activities.

• Native-level French proficiency.
